paperDeep.$description: Sunken areas, input fields, alternating rows.

void.$description: Dark background AND the ink colour for borders/shadows in light mode.

ink.$description: Text, 3px borders and hard shadows (light mode).

inkOnVoid.$description: Text, borders and shadows in dark mode.

acid.$description: Primary pop. Primary CTAs, 'synced', live states, highlighter marks.

pink.$description: Secondary pop. Stickers, DMs, notifications, delivered.

blue.$description: Tertiary pop. Links, carry pouch, mesh/peer lines.

tape.$description: Masking-tape strips (render at 85% opacity, ragged ends).

stamp.$description: Rubber-stamp red. Postmarks, destructive actions, errors.

xerox.$description: Faded photocopy grey. Secondary text, disabled, timestamps.

display.$description: Headlines, wordmark, big numbers. Always lowercase.

mono.$description: Postmarks, key fingerprints (@maya·k7f2), hop counts, timestamps, debug.

hand.$description: Handwritten notes, captions on polaroids, onboarding asides.

thick.$description: Every card, button, input, avatar frame.

dashed.$description: Cut-here lines, empty states, drop zones.

pressed.$description: On press: shadow collapses and element translates +6px,+6px.

none.$description: Default for cards, buttons, inputs. Zines have corners.

pill.$description: Only for sticker reactions and status dots.

tilt.$description: Small rotations that make the layout feel hand-pasted. Deterministic per item (hash of id), never random per render.

grain.$description: Xerox grain on every screen background.

halftone.$description: Behind empty states and image placeholders.

press.$description: Shadow collapse on tap. Steppy, not eased.

enter.$description: Cards slap down: scale 1.04 → 1, rotate ±3deg → resting tilt.

sticker.$description: Sticker overshoot when stuck onto a post.

motion.reducedMotion: Respect OS setting: disable tilt animation and overshoot, keep static tilt.

voice.case: lowercase everywhere except proper nouns and @handles
voice.tone: unbothered, warm, a little smug about not needing the internet
examples: write these down. like, on paper.
